comments: Decision given in chat on 2026-09-04 and transcribed here by the orchestrator; the artifact, not the message, is the approval. All 8 scenarios approved at artifactVersion 2. This decision explicitly confirms the interface judgement in section 2 of the review package: no ETA-351 acceptance criterion is API-verifiable, and all eight scenarios are UI. The judgement rests on reports/validation/ecore-api-discovery.json, which records that eCore sign-in is a form POST returning 302 with no token and no JSON body and that the login page issues no XHR. The sign-in journey therefore keeps its end-to-end UI proof. The six ambiguities AMB-ETA-351-001 to -006 remain REVIEW_REQUIRED and are still unanswered, so the scenarios that depend on them stay deliberately abstract; approving this plan does not resolve them.

itemDecisions.comment: A way to declare the sign-in kind exists before any details are entered. UI.
Both sign-in kinds are offered and distinguishable. UI.
Choosing organization sign-in changes which details are asked for. UI. Stays abstract pending AMB-ETA-351-001.
The password is not readable on screen. UI. Uses a fabricated secret that is typed but never submitted.
Correct details reach the Home page. UI. The only scenario that uses the real organization account.
Wrong details are refused and reported. UI. Fabricated credentials only; no message text asserted.
Missing details are refused and reported. UI. No message text asserted.
The two failure responses are distinguishable. UI. Both attempts happen inside one scenario so the comparison is evidenced, not inferred.
